edits.original: Operators procured spinning reserve, rather than non-spinning reserve.
edits.replacement: Operators procured spinning reserve. This is generating capacity that is already online and synchronized to the grid, so it can pick up load right away.
edits.reason: "Non-spinning reserve" is a technical term, not an everyday opposite, so the real distinction gets its own sentence saying what spinning reserve is.

edits.original: Those upgrades are planned on purpose, rather than by accident.
edits.replacement: Those upgrades are planned on purpose.
edits.reason: "By accident" is the everyday opposite of "on purpose," so the added clause tells the reader nothing new.
